reason: Meiku keeps PIN quick unlock because it is substantially more reliable and usable for this single-vault product than the previous WebAuthn PRF implementation.
policy: security.md: authentication credentials and tokens must not be stored in localStorage
security_assessment: The persisted blob contains AES-GCM encrypted client-vault credentials, never plaintext. New PINs require six digits and one million PBKDF2-SHA-256 iterations. Plaintext write secrets are limited to sessionStorage, auto-lock remains five minutes, password changes and sign-out clear the PIN, and legacy passkey data is removed. Offline PIN guessing remains the accepted residual risk and must be reviewed by the stated date.
